1966.long_comment: The Sixers will be resting several players for this contest, and James is one of the many projected starters who will be taking a seat alongside Joel Embiid and Jaylen Brown. The 76ers will manage James' workload carefully with an eye toward having him ready for the regular-season opener against the Knicks on Tuesday, Oct. 20.
1966.name: LeBron James
1966.short_comment: James (rest) won't be available for Saturday's preseason contest against the Celtics, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.

2490149.long_comment: McCollum and most of Atlanta's regulars won't play in the penultimate preseason game. He recorded 12 points (2-4 FG, 1-2 3Pt, 7-7 FT) and five rebounds across 19 minutes in Saturday's 119-117 preseason win over the Pacers.
2490149.name: CJ McCollum
2490149.short_comment: McCollum (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

2530530.long_comment: McConnell has yet to appear in a preseason contest and has also missed practice time, though Indiana hasn't disclosed the reason for his absence. The veteran guard will sit out alongside Andrew Nembhard, Aaron Nesmith and Jarace Walker, potentially opening additional opportunities for the Pacers' younger players. McConnell's final chance to suit up during the preseason will come Friday against Milwaukee.
2530530.name: T.J. McConnell
2530530.short_comment: McConnell (undisclosed) will not play in Tuesday's preseason matchup against Oklahoma City, Scott Agness of Fieldhouse Files reports.

2581018.long_comment: LeBron James (rest), Joel Embiid (rest) and Jaylen Brown (rest) will join Caldwell-Pope on the inactive list for Saturday's exhibition, which may result in major minutes for Rayan Rupert and Caleb Love. Caldwell-Pope's next chance to play will come Friday in a rematch with the Celtics.
2581018.name: Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
2581018.short_comment: Caldwell-Pope (rest) won't play in Saturday's exhibition against the Celtics, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.

2991139.long_comment: After appearing in each of the Clippers' first two preseason games, Dunn will be sidelined Wednesday for rest purposes. The veteran guard's next chance to suit up will come in the club's regular-season opener Oct. 21 against the Kings, when he could see an elevated role with Bradley Beal (knee) ruled out for Opening Night.
2991139.name: Kris Dunn
2991139.short_comment: Dunn (rest) has been ruled out for Wednesday's preseason game against the Nuggets, independent Clippers reporter Joey Linn reports.

2991230.long_comment: VanVleet made his first appearance since suffering an ACL injury more than a year ago, finishing with 17 points (5-12 FG, 5-12 3Pt, 2-3 FT), seven assists, two rebounds and two steals in 24 minutes during Friday's 135-117 preseason win over Dallas. The veteran point guard will likely be limited throughout the 2026-27 season, but he's on track to be the starting point guard on Opening Night.
2991230.name: Fred VanVleet
2991230.short_comment: VanVleet (rest) isn't expected to play in Sunday's preseason game against the Mavericks, Will Guillory of The Athletic reports.

2991235.long_comment: Adams totaled two points (1-1 FG), three rebounds, one assist and one steal in 14 minutes during Friday's 135-117 preseason win over the Mavericks, marking his first game action since undergoing ankle surgery in January. The veteran center is expected to be the primary backup to Alperen Sengun this season.
2991235.name: Steven Adams
2991235.short_comment: Adams (rest) isn't expected to play in Sunday's preseason game against the Mavericks, Will Guillory of The Athletic reports.

3059318.long_comment: Head coach Nick Nurse is resting most of the vets for Saturday's exhibition, so Jabari Walker could get all the run he can handle. Embiid should return for Friday's preseason rematch with Boston.
3059318.name: Joel Embiid
3059318.short_comment: Embiid (rest) is out for Saturday's exhibition against the Celtics, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.

3064440.long_comment: LaVine is among eight Kings players ruled out for Tuesday's contest. His next opportunity to play will come Friday against San Antonio in the preseason finale.
3064440.name: Zach LaVine
3064440.short_comment: LaVine (rest) will not play in Tuesday's preseason matchup against Portland, Matt George of ABC 10 Sacramento reports.

3064560.long_comment: Kornet has appeared in all three of the Spurs' preseason games. As a result, he will take the night off Wednesday, with his final opportunity to suit up before the start of the 2026-27 campaign coming Friday versus Sacramento.
3064560.name: Luke Kornet
3064560.short_comment: Kornet (rest) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Suns, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

3102530.long_comment: Nurkic will begin the 2026-27 season on the sidelines, and given the tricky nature of foot injuries for big men, it wouldn't be shocking to see his absence extend beyond this initial four-week window. Jaren Jackson will likely spend more time at center while Nurkic is out, and there will be more minutes available for Jaxson Hayes and Mo Bamba.
3102530.name: Jusuf Nurkic
3102530.short_comment: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

3102531.long_comment: Head coach Steve Kerr still has no update on Porzingis' timeline for a return, per Luca Evans of the San Francisco Chronicle. With so much camp time missed, the big man's status for the start of the regular season remains in serious doubt at this point.
3102531.name: Kristaps Porzingis
3102531.short_comment: Porzingis (undisclosed) returned Thursday to the Warriors' practice facility, per Anthony Slater of ESPN.com.

3133628.long_comment: Turner started in all three of Milwaukee's preseason games thus far, averaging 10.3 points, 4.0 rebounds, 1.0 steals and 2.7 blocks over 21.7 minutes per contest. It's unknown if he will suit up for Friday's preseason meeting with the Pacers, Milwaukee's final exhibition before the start of the regular season on Oct. 21 in Washington.
3133628.name: Myles Turner
3133628.short_comment: Turner (rest) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against Chicago, Cameron Ezeir of CBS58 reports.

3134907.long_comment: Kuzma is joining a number of Milwaukee regulars on the sidelines for this exhibition. Friday's matchup with the Pacers is his next chance to play.
3134907.name: Kyle Kuzma
3134907.short_comment: Kuzma (rest) won't play Wednesday against the Bulls, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

3135045.long_comment: Allen missed Sunday's game due to right knee soreness and remained sidelined for Wednesday's defeat. His final chance to suit up during the preseason will come Friday against the Grizzlies.
3135045.name: Grayson Allen
3135045.short_comment: Allen (knee) did not play in Wednesday's 114-93 preseason loss to the Celtics.

3136193.long_comment: Booker will get another night off Wednesday. His final chance to get on the floor this preseason will come Friday against the Jazz.
3136193.name: Devin Booker
3136193.short_comment: Booker (rest) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Spurs, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

3155526.long_comment: Brooks joins a lengthy list of Phoenix players expected to be unavailable, opening additional opportunities on the wing. With the Suns' preseason schedule wrapping up Friday against Utah, his next appearance could come in that contest.
3155526.name: Dillon Brooks
3155526.short_comment: Brooks is unlikely to suit up for Wednesday's preseason meeting with San Antonio after sitting out the full morning shootaround, Duane Rankin of The Arizona Republic reports.

3155942.long_comment: Sabonis joins several Sacramento regulars on the sidelines Tuesday, though no reason for his absence was provided. With both Sabonis and Maxime Raynaud (knee) unavailable, the Kings will need to rely on other frontcourt options against the Trail Blazers. Sabonis' next opportunity to suit up will come Friday against San Antonio.
3155942.name: Domantas Sabonis
3155942.short_comment: Sabonis (undisclosed) will not play in Tuesday's preseason matchup against Portland, Matt George of ABC 10 Sacramento reports.

3202.long_comment: According to coach Ime Udoka, Durant was initially scheduled to play only the first half Friday but requested additional minutes to build chemistry with Fred VanVleet and his other new teammates. The veteran forward's absence Sunday appears to be a planned precaution rather than an injury-related setback, and Houston should have additional minutes available for its other wings and forwards
3202.name: Kevin Durant
3202.short_comment: Durant will not play in Sunday's preseason rematch against Dallas, Varun Shankar of the Houston Chronicle reports. The forward finished Friday's preseason contest with 15 points (7-12 FG, 1-1 3Pt, 0-1 FT), two assists and one block in 23 minutes.

3213.long_comment: The veteran center isn't making the trip to Las Vegas for this exhibition. He'll look to return for Friday's preseason finale versus Portland.
3213.name: Al Horford
3213.short_comment: Horford (rest) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Lakers, per Nick Friedell of The Athletic.

3904625.long_comment: This is a tough blow for Fall, as he's already facing an uphill battle to make the final roster. A return Oct. 16 isn't out of the question based on this timetable.
3904625.name: Tacko Fall
3904625.short_comment: Fall was diagnosed with a left hip strain Thursday and will miss at least two weeks, Kyle Neubeck of AllPHLY.com reports.

3907387.long_comment: Simmons will get the night off Tuesday. His final chance to play in the preseason will come against the Spurs on Friday.
3907387.name: Ben Simmons
3907387.short_comment: Simmons (rest) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Matt George of ABC 10 Sacramento reports.

3907497.long_comment: Murray has appeared in just one preseason game due to a toe injury. The Pelicans play their final exhibition Friday versus Washington, though it's unknown if Murray will suit up for that contest.
3907497.name: Dejounte Murray
3907497.short_comment: Murray (toe) won't play in Wednesday's game versus the Mavericks, Ron Harrod reports.

3913174.long_comment: Coach Jordan Ott said following the game that Kennard was in good spirits despite the discomfort, and the team will evaluate how his knee responds Friday. The severity of the issue remains unclear, making his status worth monitoring as the regular season approaches.
3913174.name: Luke Kennard
3913174.short_comment: Kennard experienced soreness in his left knee during Wednesday's preseason game, Amanda Pflugrad of 3TV Phoenix reports.

3913176.long_comment: The Clippers learned about the injury this summer, though it's unclear exactly how far along Ingram is in his recovery. The star forward's timeline for a return is unclear, clouding his fantasy outlook in the meantime. Darius Garland should take on all the usage he can handle in Ingram's stead, while Kris Dunn and Max Strus could have additional streaming appeal early in the year.
3913176.name: Brandon Ingram
3913176.short_comment: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

3917376.long_comment: Brown will skip his first meeting against his former team in Boston, but he should be able to get back out there for Friday's rematch with the Celtics. Justin Edwards and Dean Wade will help pick up the slack Saturday with Brown unavailable.
3917376.name: Jaylen Brown
3917376.short_comment: Brown (rest) won't suit up for Saturday's preseason game in Boston, Tony Jones of The Athletic reports.

3934673.long_comment: DiVincenzo is approaching six months since tearing his right Achilles during the first round of the playoffs and has been rehabbing with the expectation that he'll play at some point this season. The veteran guard has sought advice from Jayson Tatum, Tyrese Haliburton and Damian Lillard during his recovery, though Minnesota has yet to establish a timetable for his return.
3934673.name: Donte DiVincenzo
3934673.short_comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

3945274.long_comment: There is no injury to report and this is reported to be a planned night off for Doncic. He will have one more chance to get some exhibition reps in Friday against Denver.
3945274.name: Luka Doncic
3945274.short_comment: Doncic will be rested for Tuesday's preseason game against the Warriors, Khobi Price of The California Post reports.

3950760.long_comment: Kelley signed a deal with Miami on Thursday but has yet to see any game action. His current health status hasn't been disclosed, though the big man's Summer League stint was cut short by a right calf strain that could still be a factor. Kelley's final chance to suit up during the preseason will come Friday against the Magic.
3950760.name: Kylor Kelley
3950760.short_comment: Kelley (calf) did not play during Saturday's 144-128 preseason win over Brooklyn.

3978.long_comment: The Nuggets' starters will all suit up versus Los Angeles, though the team will be without its top bench option. DeRozan has had a quiet preseason, averaging 4.7 points, 1.3 rebounds and 1.3 assists across 10.2 minutes per contest. However, it's reasonable to assume he will be much more productive come the start of the regular season.
3978.name: DeMar DeRozan
3978.short_comment: DeRozan (rest) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Clippers, Katy Winge of Altitude Sports reports.

4065654.long_comment: Isaac previously missed time during the preseason due to personal reasons but has since rejoined the team on the court. Although his participation in practice is a positive development, his status for Friday's exhibition against Miami has yet to be determined. The Magic now have their full roster participating in on-court activities.
4065654.name: Jonathan Isaac
4065654.short_comment: Isaac (personal, knee) participated in Thursday's practice but is still ramping up his activity, according to Orlando Magic Daily.

4065732.long_comment: Hunter will join several other regulars on the inactive list. His final chance to play in the preseason will come Friday against the Spurs.
4065732.name: De'Andre Hunter
4065732.short_comment: Hunter (rest) has been ruled out for Tuesday's preseason game against the Trail Blazers, Matt George of ABC 10 Sacramento reports.

4065778.long_comment: Plantar fascia injuries can be tricky to recover from, with the only remedy typically being prolonged rest, so don't be surprised if Strus' absence extends well beyond this initial four-week window. With Strus now set to miss at least the first few weeks of the season, and Bradley Beal (knee) uncertain for opening night, Keaton Wagler could be thrust into the first unit sooner than expected.
4065778.name: Max Strus
4065778.short_comment: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

4066218.long_comment: Williams will be re-evaluated the first week of the regular season, putting his status for Opening Night in the air. Williams will have a difficult path to minutes this season as he competes with the likes of Naz Reid, Royce O'Neale and Tidjane Salaun.
4066218.name: Grant Williams
4066218.short_comment: Williams will miss the preseason after suffering a right hamstring injury, the Hornets announced Friday.

4066261.long_comment: The star big man is dealing with minor right groin tightness. Friday's game against the Magic is his next chance to play.
4066261.name: Bam Adebayo
4066261.short_comment: Adebayo (groin) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Nets, Eric Nehm of The Athletic reports.

4066262.long_comment: Monk is one of several Kings guards who will be unavailable Tuesday, joining Zach LaVine, Ben Simmons and Darius Acuff on the sidelines. His next chance to see preseason action will come Friday against San Antonio.
4066262.name: Malik Monk
4066262.short_comment: Monk (rest) is out for Tuesday's preseason game against Portland, Matt George of ABC 10 Sacramento reports.

4066383.long_comment: Bridges and the other veterans on the roster will sit this one out. His final opportunity to get on the floor before the start of the regular season will come Friday versus the Jazz.
4066383.name: Miles Bridges
4066383.short_comment: Bridges (rest) won't play Wednesday against the Spurs, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

4066650.long_comment: Collins has yet to suit up in the preseason due to a toe injury but is making progress ahead of the regular season. The big man's final chance to suit up in the preseason will come Friday against Minnesota.
4066650.name: Zach Collins
4066650.short_comment: Collins (toe) is progressing in his recovery but has been ruled out for Wednesday's preseason meeting with the Bucks, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

4066757.long_comment: Merrill will be held out of Cleveland's preseason finale due to right elbow soreness. The 30-year-old sharpshooter's next opportunity to play will come in the Cavaliers' regular-season opener against Philadelphia on Thursday, Oct. 22.
4066757.name: Sam Merrill
4066757.short_comment: Merrill (elbow) has been ruled out for Tuesday's preseason game against the Magic, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.

4066993.long_comment: This is a tough blow for the point guard who was penciled in as the top backup behind Davion Mitchell. If he indeed misses a couple weeks, he could be back in time for their final preseason contest Oct. 16.
4066993.name: Dru Smith
4066993.short_comment: Smith will miss a couple weeks with a strained right calf, Ira Winderman of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

4277811.long_comment: Sexton is considered day-to-day with a lower-leg injury and didn't scrimmage Thursday. He can be viewed as questionable for Friday's preseason finale against Denver until the Lakers provide an update on his status.
4277811.name: Collin Sexton
4277811.short_comment: Sexton (lower leg) participated in Thursday's practice but didn't take part in any live action, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

4277843.long_comment: The Bucks are giving the veteran swingman Wednesday night off. His next chance for preseason action is Friday against the Pacers.
4277843.name: Gary Trent Jr.
4277843.short_comment: Trent (rest) won't play Wednesday against the Bulls, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

4278049.long_comment: The big man is receiving a maintenance day Wednesday. His next chance to play comes Friday against the Hawks.
4278049.name: Daniel Gafford
4278049.short_comment: Gafford (rest) won't play Wednesday against the Pelicans, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

4278067.long_comment: This is a huge blow for Claxton and it rules him out for the entire preseason. For now, fantasy managers can consider him questionable for Opening Night on Oct. 21 against the Raptors. Jalen Smith is the next man up on the depth chart for Chicago, followed by Zach Collins (toe).
4278067.name: Nic Claxton
4278067.short_comment: Claxton tweaked his hamstring and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Chuck Swirsky of the Bulls Radio Network of the Bulls Radio Network reports.

4278585.long_comment: Gillespie has appeared in three preseason games for the Suns in 2026, averaging 16.9 minutes per contest. However, as expected, the 27-year-old will rest Wednesday, with his final chance to see more preseason action coming Friday versus Utah.
4278585.name: Collin Gillespie
4278585.short_comment: Gillespie (rest) won't play in Wednesday's game against the Spurs, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

4351851.long_comment: Simons is trending in the right direction and was able to practice in full Thursday. The 76ers will take a cautious approach for the final exhibition, however.
4351851.name: Anfernee Simons
4351851.short_comment: Simons (hamstring) is out for Friday's preseason game against the Celtics, Kyle Neubeck of AllPHLY.com reports.

4395651.long_comment: White missed time with a left calf strain last season and is now in jeopardy of starting the regular season on the inactive list. If the 26-year-old guard is forced to miss time beyond the preseason, Christian Anderson and Dennis Schroder would likely see increased playing time.
4395651.name: Coby White
4395651.short_comment: The Hornets announced Monday that White suffered a left calf strain during training camp and will not play during the preseason.

4395712.long_comment: It's unclear if Nembhard is dealing with an injury, though it's possible he's just receiving a rest day. His final chance to play before the regular season will come Friday against Milwaukee.
4395712.name: Andrew Nembhard
4395712.short_comment: Nembhard (undisclosed) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Thunder, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.

4395723.long_comment: Johnson will get a rest day after playing in each of San Antonio's first three preseason games. His next chance to suit up will come Friday against Sacramento.
4395723.name: Keldon Johnson
4395723.short_comment: Johnson (rest) has been ruled out for Wednesday's preseason game against Phoenix, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

4395725.long_comment: The star guard is receiving a rest day Wednesday. His last chance for exhibition reps arrives Friday against the Pacers.
4395725.name: Tyler Herro
4395725.short_comment: Herro (rest) won't play Wednesday against the Bulls, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

4396818.long_comment: It's a tough break for Miller, who had an opportunity to battle for a reserve role during training camp in the fall. The timeline for a return is likely to keep him on the shelf until after the All-Star break. Miller's extended stay on the sidelines gives Kobe Sanders a chance to crack the Clippers' rotation.
4396818.name: Jordan Miller
4396818.short_comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

4396909.long_comment: Nesmith revealed Thursday that a hamstring injury kept him out of Tuesday's exhibition against Oklahoma City, though he described himself as feeling "pretty good." The 27-year-old forward will finish the preseason on the sidelines, and his availability for Indiana's regular-season opener remains uncertain. Kelly Oubre and Ben Sheppard could see additional opportunities on the wing if Nesmith's absence extends into the regular season.
4396909.name: Aaron Nesmith
4396909.short_comment: Nesmith (hamstring) will not play in Friday's preseason finale against Milwaukee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

4396963.long_comment: Hinson is managing a left adductor injury that'll keep him sidelined Monday. The forward appeared in Utah's first two preseason games, and his next chance to suit up will come Friday against Phoenix.
4396963.name: Blake Hinson
4396963.short_comment: Hinson (adductor) has been ruled out for Monday's preseason game against San Antonio.

4397002.long_comment: Dosunmu won't travel with the Timberwolves but is expected to be ready to go for their regular-season opener against the Heat on Wednesday. With the 26-year-old sidelined, Terrence Shannon, Isaiah Evans and Bones Hyland could see increased playing time.
4397002.name: Ayo Dosunmu
4397002.short_comment: Dosunmu isn't dealing with an injury but will sit out Friday's preseason finale against the Bulls for rest purposes, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

4397020.long_comment: Dort is sitting out Monday for maintenance purposes. The veteran swingman's next chance to play is Friday against Dallas.
4397020.name: Luguentz Dort
4397020.short_comment: Dort (rest) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

4397140.long_comment: Porter has appeared in two of the Bucks' preseason games. His final chance to play before the start of the regular season will come Friday against Indiana.
4397140.name: Kevin Porter Jr.
4397140.short_comment: Porter (rest) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against Chicago, Cameron Ezeir of CBS58 reports.

4397183.long_comment: Wiggins and most of Atlanta's regulars won't play in the penultimate preseason game. He finished with 13 points (4-9 FG, 3-6 3Pt, 2-2 FT), two rebounds, an assist and two steals across 20 minutes off the bench in Saturday's 119-117 preseason win over the Pacers.
4397183.name: Aaron Wiggins
4397183.short_comment: Wiggins (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

4397475.long_comment: Green has played in two of Milwaukee's preseason contests. His final opportunity to get on the floor before the start of the 2026-27 campaign will come Friday in Indiana.
4397475.name: AJ Green
4397475.short_comment: Green (rest) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against Chicago, Cameron Ezeir of CBS58 reports.

4431679.long_comment: Achiuwa started at center and posted a double-double before leaving late with a right ankle injury and being ruled out. With Maxime Raynaud (knee) and Dylan Cardwell (calf) each expected to miss at least two weeks, the severity of the ankle injury matters a lot for Sacramento's frontcourt depth.
4431679.name: Precious Achiuwa
4431679.short_comment: Precious Achiuwa exited Tuesday's game with a right ankle injury and did not return, per Jason Anderson of the Sacramento Bee.

4431680.long_comment: Okongwu is getting the night off Monday with Atlanta resting a number of starters. His next chance to play arrives Friday against Dallas.
4431680.name: Onyeka Okongwu
4431680.short_comment: Okongwu (rest) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

4432107.long_comment: Coach Dusty May indicated Thursday that he anticipates Sasser returning after dealing with left adductor tightness. The guard's expected availability should give Dallas another backcourt option for its final exhibition, though it's unclear whether he'll face any minutes restrictions.
4432107.name: Marcus Sasser
4432107.short_comment: Sasser (groin) is expected to play in Friday's preseason finale against Atlanta, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

4432171.long_comment: Moody suffered the injury March 23 and underwent season-ending surgery four days later. The 24-year-old had been targeting September to resume running and on-court work, so his latest progress appears to keep his rehabilitation on track, though he remains without a firm timetable for his return to game action.
4432171.name: Moses Moody
4432171.short_comment: Moody has progressed to light on-court activities as he continues his recovery from a ruptured left patellar tendon, Evan Webeck of The Mercury News reports.

4432181.long_comment: Strawther exited to the locker room in the third quarter of Wednesday's loss to the Clippers after his left knee bent awkwardly following contact while handling the ball. "All you can do is hope for the best," said Nuggets head coach David Adelman. An extended absence for Strawther would test Denver's depth on the wing with Spencer Jones (hamstring) not yet cleared for contact.
4432181.name: Julian Strawther
4432181.short_comment: Strawther (knee) will undergo an MRI on Thursday morning, Katy Winge of Altitude Sports reports.

4432185.long_comment: Peavy will end up missing the entirety of the preseason due to an ankle injury. His next opportunity to suit up will come in Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Jazz.
4432185.name: Micah Peavy
4432185.short_comment: Head coach Tumos Iisalo said Thursday that Peavy (ankle) has progressed well in his recovery, though he won't play in Friday's preseason finale against Charlotte, Anthony Sain of Buff City Media reports.

4432586.long_comment: Bittle can presumably be ruled out for the remainder of the preseason as he works his way back to full health. The big man was spotted in a walking boot in early September and remains without a clear timetable for a return to game action.
4432586.name: Nate Bittle
4432586.short_comment: Bittle (foot) is still in a walking boot, but he has a follow-up appointment Wednesday and could ditch the boot if all goes well, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

4432810.long_comment: Stewart, who was traded from Detroit to Memphis over the summer, sustained a left ankle sprain in the team's preseason opener and is now likely to miss Opening Night. His absence opens the door for Quinten Post to move into the backup center role behind Zach Edey in the interim.
4432810.name: Isaiah Stewart
4432810.short_comment: The Grizzlies announced Friday that Stewart (ankle) will miss at least two weeks.

4432822.long_comment: Okoro missed practice Tuesday and was ultimately sidelined Wednesday due to an undisclosed issue. The wing's next chance to suit up will come Friday against Minnesota.
4432822.name: Isaac Okoro
4432822.short_comment: Okoro (undisclosed) was unavailable for Wednesday's preseason game against Milwaukee, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.

4432823.long_comment: Williams is still dealing with a heel injury and won't play in the second half of this back-to-back set. The big man's final chance to see game action ahead of the regular season will come Thursday against Houston.
4432823.name: Jaylin Williams
4432823.short_comment: Williams (heel) has been ruled out for Tuesday's preseason game against the Pacers, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

4432848.long_comment: The Bucks are set to rest a number of key players for this exhibition. Jaquez's last chance for preseason reps comes Friday against the Pacers.
4432848.name: Jaime Jaquez Jr.
4432848.short_comment: Jaquez (rest) won't play Wednesday against the Bulls, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

4433137.long_comment: Williams has been dealing with a foot contusion recently, though he's trending in the right direction ahead of Friday's preseason finale against Denver. The 25-year-old swingman can be considered questionable for that contest until the Lakers provide an update on his status.
4433137.name: Ziaire Williams
4433137.short_comment: Williams (foot) was a full participant in Thursday's practice, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

4433174.long_comment: Cardwell appeared in 44 games last season, providing frontcourt depth while Domantas Sabonis dealt with injuries. Sacramento will also be without Maxime Raynaud (knee) to begin the campaign, leaving the team thin at center behind Sabonis. Cardwell's return timetable remains uncertain, but his absence could create additional opportunities for the Kings' remaining frontcourt reserves.
4433174.name: Dylan Cardwell
4433174.short_comment: Cardwell (calf) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, with a longer absence possible, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

4433188.long_comment: Carter will miss a second consecutive game due to an illness. His next chance to suit up could come Friday against Philadelphia.
4433188.name: Devin Carter
4433188.short_comment: Carter (illness) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against Charlotte, Bobby Krivitsky of Forbes.com reports.

4433255.long_comment: Holmgren has yet to play in the preseason due to a quad contusion and will remain on the inactive list in the second leg of this back-to-back set. The big man's final chance to suit up before the regular season will come Thursday versus Houston.
4433255.name: Chet Holmgren
4433255.short_comment: Holmgren (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Tuesday's preseason game against the Pacers, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

4437244.long_comment: Green was expected to sit this one out, so the latest update isn't surprising. His final chance to suit up before the start of the regular season will come Friday against Utah.
4437244.name: Jalen Green
4437244.short_comment: Green (rest) won't play Wednesday versus the Spurs, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

4585618.long_comment: Gilbert continues to deal with patella tendinitis. His last chance to appear this preseason is Friday against the Mavericks.
4585618.name: Keshon Gilbert
4585618.short_comment: Gilbert (knee) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, per Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network.

4591725.long_comment: Rollins will take the night off before possibly suiting up for Friday's preseason meeting with the Pacers. The 24-year-old has played relatively well during the preseason (three games), averaging 13.0 points, 3.7 rebounds, 3.3 assists, 1.7 blocks and 1.3 steals over 19.4 minutes per contest.
4591725.name: Ryan Rollins
4591725.short_comment: Rollins (rest) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against Chicago, Cameron Ezeir of CBS58 reports.

4592427.long_comment: It appears unlikely that Jones will be recovered from a hamstring injury in time to receive any preseason reps. Given where he's at in his rehab, Jones' status for the start of the regular season is in limbo as well.
4592427.name: Spencer Jones
4592427.short_comment: Jones (hamstring) remains limited to non-contact work, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

4592479.long_comment: Champagnie started San Antonio's first three preseason games but will get Wednesday off for rest purposes. His next chance to suit up will come Friday against Sacramento.
4592479.name: Julian Champagnie
4592479.short_comment: Champagnie (rest) has been ruled out for Wednesday's preseason game against Phoenix, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

4592699.long_comment: Freeman exited Saturday's contest against Miami due to a right shoulder injury and has since missed two consecutive games. The forward's final opportunity to suit up during the preseason will come Friday against Chicago.
4592699.name: Enrique Freeman
4592699.short_comment: Freeman (shoulder) did not play in Wednesday's 128-106 preseason loss to Detroit.

4593125.long_comment: Coach Dusty May said Thursday that Aldama is getting "much, much closer" to returning but doesn't expect him to play against the Hawks. Although the forward appears to be making progress, his availability for the beginning of the regular season remains uncertain. Dallas could continue leaning on its other frontcourt options until Aldama is cleared to return.
4593125.name: Santi Aldama
4593125.short_comment: Aldama is unlikely to suit up for Friday's preseason finale against Atlanta, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

4601023.long_comment: Ighodaro averaged 17.5 minutes in the Suns' first three preseason games, though he will take the night off Wednesday to rest. His final chance to play before the start of the 2026-27 campaign will come Friday versus Utah.
4601023.name: Oso Ighodaro
4601023.short_comment: Ighodaro (rest) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Spurs, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

4601025.long_comment: Larsson was initially deemed doubtful to play Thursday. He remains day-to-day while dealing with an illness.
4601025.name: Pelle Larsson
4601025.short_comment: Larsson (illness) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Nets, Eric Nehm of The Athletic reports.

4606840.long_comment: Watkins, a two-way player for the Wizards, suffered the injury during the Summer League. Although Washington has yet to offer a timetable for a return, a typical recovery time for the procedure is approximately 9-to-12 months. That leaves Watkins in serious jeopardy of missing most, if not all, of the 2026-27 season, and it remains to be seen if the team will continue keeping him around on a two-way roster spot while he's injured.
4606840.name: Jamir Watkins
4606840.short_comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

4683688.long_comment: Lively underwent right foot surgery in December and has progressed to some shooting and on-court work, but the big man isn't quite ready to return to game action. His next chance to suit up will come Friday against Atlanta, though there's been no indication of an imminent return, and Lively could ultimately miss time to begin the regular season.
4683688.name: Dereck Lively II
4683688.short_comment: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Wednesday's preseason game against New Orleans, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.

4684269.long_comment: It doesn't sound like the two-way guard will be available for the preseason, but he's hopeful to not miss any time during the G League season. Boswell is not expected to be a significant part of the Hornets' rotation this season.
4684269.name: Kylan Boswell
4684269.short_comment: Boswell is rehabbing a right knee injury, and he's hopeful to be cleared for basketball activities prior to the start of the G League season in late October.

4684793.long_comment: Filipowski tweaked his back while lifting in the 2025-26 offseason, which caused painful sciatica down his leg throughout the campaign and limited his explosiveness. This offseason, he underwent surgery to fix the herniated disc in his back that was causing the pain, and he's still rehabbing. With Jusuf Nurkic (foot) slated to miss Opening Night, Filipowski's availability moving forward will be one to monitor closely.
4684793.name: Kyle Filipowski
4684793.short_comment: Jazz head coach Will Hardy said Saturday that Filipowski is progressing well and doing the necessary steps to get back on the court, but the big man doesn't have a return timeline, Shreyas Laddha of The Salt Lake Tribune reports.

4701208.long_comment: Cisse sprained his left ankle in Wednesday's loss to the Pelicans and could sit out Friday's preseason finale against the Hawks as a precautionary measure. Even if he doesn't play Friday, it appears Cisse is trending toward being available for Wednesday's regular-season opener against Houston.
4701208.name: Moussa Cisse
4701208.short_comment: Head coach Dusty May said Cisse (ankle) didn't practice Thursday as a precaution but added that the big man "would've been able to play" if there was a game, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

4701230.long_comment: Johnson and most of Atlanta's regulars won't suit up for the penultimate preseason contest. He tallied 20 points (8-12 FG, 2-2 3Pt, 2-3 FT), seven rebounds and three assists over 25 minutes in Saturday's 119-117 preseason win over the Pacers.
4701230.name: Jalen Johnson
4701230.short_comment: Johnson (rest) won't play in Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

4701232.long_comment: This is a tough blow for the center with training camp right around the corner. With his status for Opening Night in jeopardy, this will put a lot of eyes on Oso Ighodaro and Khaman Maluach, with the latter already drawing buzz during the Summer League. More clarity on Williams' timeline should be known in the coming weeks.
4701232.name: Mark Williams
4701232.short_comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

4702352.long_comment: While Sanders isn't available for the Clippers' final preseason game, the team is optimistic he will be cleared to suit up for Opening Night against the Kings. With Max Strus (foot), Bradley Beal (knee) and Brandon Ingram (Achilles) all sidelined to begin the 2026-27 campaign, Sanders might be in line for a more prominent role. The 24-year-old appeared in 68 regular-season games as a rookie in 2024-25, starting 16 of them, averaging 7.3 points, 2.3 rebounds and 1.6 assists over 19.9 minutes per contest.
4702352.name: Kobe Sanders
4702352.short_comment: Sanders (hip) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game against the Nuggets, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

4706557.long_comment: Youngblood will miss his second exhibition game in as many days due to left calf soreness. His final chance to play again in the preseason will come Friday against Golden State.
4706557.name: Chris Youngblood
4706557.short_comment: Youngblood (calf) has been ruled out for Tuesday's preseason game against the Kings.

4712849.long_comment: Black has been working his way back from a right ankle sprain, and his participation in practice marks another step toward a return to game action. However, his availability for Friday's preseason finale against Miami remains uncertain. Orlando may elect to take a cautious approach with the guard ahead of the regular season.
4712849.name: Anthony Black
4712849.short_comment: Black (ankle) participated in Thursday's practice but remains in the process of ramping up his activity, according to Orlando Magic Daily.

4712863.long_comment: Gueye will be re-evaluated by medical staff in 3-to-4 months, which means he'll miss all of training camp and preseason and likely the start of the 2026-27 regular season. It's a brutal blow for the fourth-year big man, given that the Hawks used the No. 23 overall pick of the 2026 NBA Draft to select St. John's product Zuby Ejiofor. Gueye's absence means Ejiofor will have more opportunities in the preseason, and the rookie could establish a key role off the bench behind Onyeka Okongwu and projected backup center Jock Landale (ankle).
4712863.name: Mouhamed Gueye
4712863.short_comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

4869342.long_comment: Daniels and most of Atlanta's regulars will rest during the Hawks' penultimate preseason contest. He tallied 13 points (6-16 FG, 1-3 3Pt), 11 rebounds, an assist and a steal across 21 minutes in Thursday's 123-116 preseason win over the Spurs but struggled with his shot against the Pacers on Saturday.
4869342.name: Dyson Daniels
4869342.short_comment: Daniels (rest) has been ruled out for Monday's preseason game against the Thunder, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

4870562.long_comment: Barlow has missed the entire preseason so far and remains without a timetable to return. He can be considered questionable at best for Friday's preseason finale against Boston.
4870562.name: Dominick Barlow
4870562.short_comment: Barlow (back) was unable to practice Tuesday, Noah Levick of NBC Sports Philadelphia reports.

4870564.long_comment: The rookie first-rounder will now have been sidelined for the entire preseason with a back injury, costing him valuable reps this fall. His status is up in the air for Wednesday's regular-season opener against the Hornets.
4870564.name: Joshua Jefferson
4870564.short_comment: Jefferson (back) won't play in Wednesday's preseason game versus the Heat, per Erik Slater of ClutchPoints.com.

4871141.long_comment: Hukporti went down with an Achilles injury in Monday's preseason opener against the Knicks, and an MRI has since revealed a rupture. He signed a one-year deal with the 76ers over the summer, so Hukporti will be an unrestricted free agent come season's end. With Hukporti's year already finished, Adem Bona (foot) should assume the backup center role behind Joel Embiid once healthy.
4871141.name: Ariel Hukporti
4871141.short_comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

4871144.long_comment: Sengun recorded 16 points (6-9 FG, 0-2 3Pt, 4-5 FT), 10 rebounds, 10 assists, one steal and three blocks in 22 minutes during Friday's 135-117 preseason win over Dallas but will take a seat Sunday. Sengun is coming off another impressive year, averaging 20.4 points, 8.9 rebounds, 6.2 assists, 1.2 steals and 1.1 blocks in 33.3 minutes per game across 72 regular-season appearances in 2025-26. However, the star center shot just 69.1 percent from the charity stripe and 30.5 percent from downtown. He's been focused on improving in those areas this offseason, and an uptick in efficiency would be a s
4871144.name: Alperen Sengun
4871144.short_comment: Sengun (rest) isn't expected to play in Sunday's preseason game against the Mavericks, Will Guillory of The Athletic reports.

4873153.long_comment: The rookie first-rounder missed the start of training camp with leg soreness, so Dallas is taking a cautious approach. Johnson could return for Friday's preseason finale against the Hawks.
4873153.name: Morez Johnson Jr.
4873153.short_comment: Johnson (rest) won't play Wednesday against the Pelicans, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

4898371.long_comment: Raynaud is recovering from a right patellar subluxation and appears set to begin the campaign on the sidelines. The young center appeared in 74 games last season, helping anchor Sacramento's frontcourt while Domantas Sabonis battled injuries. With Dylan Cardwell also sidelined, the Kings will be especially dependent on Sabonis until their reserve centers return.
4898371.name: Maxime Raynaud
4898371.short_comment: Raynaud (knee) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, and potentially longer, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

4900671.long_comment: Mitchell is out for both ends of this back-to-back set. His next chance to play is Thursday against the Rockets.
4900671.name: Ajay Mitchell
4900671.short_comment: Mitchell (rest) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Pacers, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

4914336.long_comment: It's a tough blow to the Trail Blazers' depth on the wing ahead of training camp. Sharpe, who is now likely to be sidelined until after the All-Star break, had been ticketed for a reserve role behind Toumani Camara following an injury-plagued 2025-26 campaign, which saw average a career-high 20.8 points, 1.4 steals and 2.1 three-pointers per game over 50 regular-season appearances. The door is now open for Vit Krejci and Jeremy Sochan to compete for bench minutes during camp.
4914336.name: Shaedon Sharpe
4914336.short_comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

4997530.long_comment: Diop is away from the team while tending to a knee injury. His next chance to rejoin Cleveland comes next Thursday for the season opener against the 76ers.
4997530.name: Khalifa Diop
4997530.short_comment: Diop (knee) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Magic, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.

4997537.long_comment: Although the big man will remain a limited participant in training camp as he continues his rehab from a hip impingement, it sounds like his absence from game action will extend into the regular season. Deandre Ayton should have the backup center role all to himself until Vukcevic is cleared to retake the floor.
4997537.name: Tristan Vukcevic
4997537.short_comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

5041939.long_comment: Flagg is getting Wednesday night off for rest purposes. He'll look to return Friday against the Hawks in what could be a dress rehearsal for the Mavericks.
5041939.name: Cooper Flagg
5041939.short_comment: Flagg (rest) won't play Wednesday against the Pelicans, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

5060631.long_comment: Thiero's practice reps are limited by an undisclosed issue. His status is uncertain for Friday's preseason finale against the Nuggets.
5060631.name: Adou Thiero
5060631.short_comment: Thiero (undisclosed) is being managed for "maintenance," per Law Murray of The Athletic.

5061575.long_comment: Knueppel's status for Opening Night remains uncertain as he continues to work his way back from his left hamstring injury. Peterson's comments suggest the Hornets aren't ready to rule out the second-year wing, though his availability will likely become clearer as training camp progresses. He has already been ruled out for the entire preseason, to be clear.
5061575.name: Kon Knueppel
5061575.short_comment: Hornets general manager Jeff Peterson said Monday that he "doesn't know" whether Knueppel (hamstring) will be available for the team's regular-season opener against the Nets, Owen Watterson of SI.com reports.

5061603.long_comment: Sorber continues to nurse a knee injury Tuesday. His next chance to play is Thursday against the Rockets.
5061603.name: Thomas Sorber
5061603.short_comment: Sorber (knee) won't play Tuesday against the Pacers, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

5101845.long_comment: The Spurs are expected to exercise extreme caution with the big man, as Quaintance suffered a torn ACL and meniscus with Arizona State in February 2025 before appearing in only four games with Kentucky last season due to severe complications and persistent swelling. The 19-year-old underwent a cleanup procedure on his meniscus in mid-July, and the Spurs will likely want him at 100 percent before ramping him up to basketball activities.
5101845.name: Jayden Quaintance
5101845.short_comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

5105555.long_comment: Awaka missed practice Tuesday and was ultimately sidelined Wednesday while managing a knee injury he sustained Friday against Memphis. The rookie's next chance to suit up will come Friday against Minnesota.
5105555.name: Tobe Awaka
5105555.short_comment: Awaka (knee) was unavailable for Wednesday's preseason game against Milwaukee, Joel Lorenzi of The Athletic reports.

5105571.long_comment: Veesaar suffered the injury during a workout on Sept. 15, and an MRI confirmed the diagnosis. The No. 52 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft, Veesaar was expected to spend a lot of time with Atlanta's G League affiliate this season.
5105571.name: Henri Veesaar
5105571.short_comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

5105637.long_comment: Bona has yet to appear in the preseason and will now miss the final exhibition. He did go through practice Thursday, however, giving him a chance to suit up for Opening Night as the backup center.
5105637.name: Adem Bona
5105637.short_comment: Bona (foot) remains out for Friday's preseason finale against the Celtics, but he's getting closer to a return, Kyle Neubeck of AllPHLY.com reports.

5105806.long_comment: Howard appeared in Dallas' first two preseason games but will be sidelined Wednesday due to an illness. His next chance to suit up will come Friday against Atlanta.
5105806.name: Jett Howard
5105806.short_comment: Howard (illness) has been ruled out for Wednesday's preseason game against New Orleans, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.

5106060.long_comment: It's unclear why Walker will be held out of the Pacers' penultimate preseason game. His final chance to play before the regular season will come against the Bucks on Friday.
5106060.name: Jarace Walker
5106060.short_comment: Walker (undisclosed) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Thunder, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.

5106268.long_comment: Tomlin is away from the team while tending to a back injury. He carries no timetable for a return.
5106268.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
5106268.short_comment: Tomlin (back) won't play in Tuesday's preseason game against the Magic, Serena Winters of FanDuel Sports Network Ohio reports.

5106270.long_comment: Oweh exited Tuesday's preseason game against the Pacers with a non-contact injury that was later diagnosed as a ruptured right Achilles tendon. The No. 41 overall pick in the 2026 NBA Draft already faced an uphill battle for playing time on a loaded Thunder roster and will now miss his entire rookie campaign. Depending on his recovery progress, Oweh could be a candidate to participate in the 2027 Summer League.
5106270.name: Otega Oweh
5106270.short_comment: Oweh (Achilles) underwent surgery Wednesday and will miss the entirety of the 2026-27 season, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.

5107251.long_comment: With Nelson still in recovery mode from the left ankle surgery he underwent this summer, his path back to game action remains delayed for the early part of the season. The rookie big man is on a two-way contract with the Magic, so his short-term absence mainly affects his developmental timeline rather than Orlando's regular rotation.
5107251.name: Izaiyah Nelson
5107251.short_comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

5108024.long_comment: Niederhauser is progressing from March surgery but won't be able to suit up to begin the year. The Clippers are likely to take a cautious approach with the 2025 first-rounder. Isaiah Jackson should occupy the backup center spot behind Brook Lopez early in the campaign.
5108024.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
5108024.short_comment: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

5113969.long_comment: Carr continues to manage a minor contusion. His status is unknown for Friday's preseason finale versus Denver.
5113969.name: Cameron Carr
5113969.short_comment: Carr (undisclosed) didn't practice Thursday, per Thuc Nhi Nguyen of the Los Angeles Times.

5142620.long_comment: The Kings will be extremely shorthanded Tuesday, as they're resting several regulars. Acuff's final chance to play in the preseason will come Friday against the Spurs.
5142620.name: Darius Acuff Jr.
5142620.short_comment: Acuff (rest) has been ruled out for Tuesday's preseason game against Portland, Matt George of ABC 10 Sacramento reports.

5157066.long_comment: Furphy started in 21 of 35 regular-season appearances for the Pacers, posting averages of 5.1 points, 4.4 rebounds, 1.2 assists and 0.7 three-pointers in 18.4 minutes per contest. While no timetable has been announced, Furphy's absence could extend through the beginning of the 2026-27 season. With this news, the Pacers will likely lean more on Ben Sheppard, Kam Jones and Quenton Jackson moving forward.
5157066.name: Johnny Furphy
5157066.short_comment: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

5157587.long_comment: Zikarsky appeared in two of Minnesota's first three preseason games but has been unavailable for the club's past two contests. His next chance to suit up will come Friday against Chicago.
5157587.name: Rocco Zikarsky
5157587.short_comment: Zikarsky (undisclosed) was unavailable for Wednesday's 128-106 preseason loss to Detroit.

5159925.long_comment: Topic is sitting out this exhibition with a back injury. He has no timeline for a return ahead of Thursday's game against the Rockets.
5159925.name: Nikola Topic
5159925.short_comment: Topic (back) won't play Tuesday against Indiana, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

5164559.long_comment: Ament will remain sidelined due to a left ankle sprain he sustained Oct. 7 against Oklahoma City. His availability for Friday's matchup against Indiana remains uncertain, though Milwaukee head coach Taylor Jenkins suggested the rookie should be ready for Opening Night.
5164559.name: Nate Ament
5164559.short_comment: Ament (ankle) is out for Wednesday's preseason game against Chicago, Cameron Ezeir of CBS Milwaukee reports.

6430.long_comment: Butler is still months away from retaking the floor, according to Nick Friedell of The Athletic, so a season debut at some point December might be too optimistic. The star forward remains without a definitive timeline for a return after undergoing ACL surgery in early February, which typically carries at least a nine-month recovery period. Butler makes sense as an injury stash at the end of fantasy drafts, but managers should likely be bracing for him to miss at least the first two months of the regular season.
6430.name: Jimmy Butler III
6430.short_comment: The Warriors hope to have Butler (knee) back early in 2027, per Keith Watkins of Yahoo Sports.

6440.long_comment: "It's a calf strain, the seriousness is what it is," said Johnson. "We won't rush him at all. I guess the question will be is he ready for the season opener? Totally questionable and we will not push that at all. So, we'll take it slow. There is no concern of this level of seriousness, and at the same time, we will not rush him at all." It sounds like Harris, who has already been ruled out for the preseason, is in danger of missing opening night. His absence will open up minutes for Julian Champagnie, Keldon Johnson and Harrison Barnes.
6440.name: Tobias Harris
6440.short_comment: Spurs head coach Mitch Johnson said they will not rush Tobias Harris (calf) back to the court, Jared Weiss of The Athletic reports.

6442.long_comment: Irving is sitting out this exhibition Wednesday. Friday's game against the Hawks marks his last chance for a tune-up.
6442.name: Kyrie Irving
6442.short_comment: Irving (rest) won't play Wednesday against the Pelicans, Mike Curtis of The Dallas Morning News reports.

6478.long_comment: It appears to be a routine maintenance day for the veteran big man. Friday's matchup versus the Heat marks his next chance to play.
6478.name: Nikola Vucevic
6478.short_comment: Vucevic (rest) is out for Tuesday's preseason game against the Cavaliers.

6580.long_comment: Beal is dealing with knee inflammation that will keep him sidelined for Opening Night. While it's unclear how long the Clippers will be without the veteran guard, Darius Garland, Keaton Wagler and Kris Dunn should dominate the backcourt minutes in his absence. Beal's 2025-26 campaign was cut short by a hip injury after he averaged 8.2 points and 1.7 assists in 20.6 minutes across just six regular-season appearances.
6580.name: Bradley Beal
6580.short_comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

6583.long_comment: Davis is getting the night off Monday for maintenance purposes. The star big man's next chance to play is Friday against the Pelicans.
6583.name: Anthony Davis
6583.short_comment: Davis (rest) is out for Monday's preseason game against the Nets, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.

6589.long_comment: The veteran big man will be held out of Tuesday's contest, with his last chance to suit up in the preseason coming Friday against Portland. Charles Bassey will get the starting nod in Green's absence.
6589.name: Draymond Green
6589.short_comment: Green (rest) has been ruled out for Tuesday's preseason game against the Lakers, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

6609.long_comment: Middleton has yet to play in the preseason as he ramps up his conditioning. The veteran forward's next chance to suit up will come Friday against New Orleans.
6609.name: Khris Middleton
6609.short_comment: Middleton (rest) was unavailable for Monday's 131-122 preseason loss to Brooklyn, Greg Finberg of Wizardscentral.com reports.
